summary: WISeKey International Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) disclosing results of the Class B share election for its previously announced cross-border redomiciliation merger into BVI subsidiary WISeQey Corp. Holders of 518 Class B shares elected 10 WISeQey Class B shares per share, yielding 5,180 Class B shares; remaining holders receive one ordinary share each, totaling 4,176,654 ordinary shares, plus 1,819,060 Class F shares for Class A. Shareholders approved the merger on September 9, 2026; closing awaits Swiss and BVI procedures. Watch for the effective date and Nasdaq/SIX trading commencement.
